Job Title - Machine Learning Scientist

Working model - hybrid at Chiasso office

Team - You will join the Strategic Analytics team in the Technology department.

Level - Professional

Location - Chiasso, Switzerland

Contract - Permanent - full-time (36 h/week)

What your impact will be:

- Develop real-time machine learning solutions to deal with challenging real-world problems on big data
- Develop Ranking Algorithms based on deep learning
- Collaborate in a cross-functional team, including machine learning scientists, software engineers, machine learning engineers, and project managers

## Requisiti e competenze

Your expertise:

- A Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, or Physics, or a Master's degree with a minimum of 3 years of experience in machine learning.
- Excellent knowledge of Supervised methods (Classification, Regression) and Unsupervised methods (Clustering, Feature Selection, Dimensionality Reduction)
- Good knowledge of Python and SQL, with knowledge of the most important Python libraries for Machine Learning and Data Analysis (scikit-learn, Pandas, matplotlib, Numpy, Scipy, MLflow)
- Experience with Deep Learning (Recurrent Neural Networks, Convolutional Neural Networks, and Autoencoders)
- Experience with Keras (and TensorFlow) or PyTorch
Desirable:

- Experience in Uncertainty Estimation (Monte Carlo Dropout, Deep Ensembles)
- Able to find creative solutions to interesting problems
- Curious with a constant desire to learn and collaborate

## Cosa offriamo

## Perks of working with us:

## How we work together: - An inclusive, friendly, and international environment (you’ll be working with colleagues from +10 countries and over 48 nationalities) - Shorter working week, with a half working day on Fridays - Flexible start and end of the working day - Possibility to work from anywhere for a period of time per year defined according to local regulations How we learn together: - Fri-Yays: half a day on Friday morning with a no-meeting mandate and dedicated to deep work, personal growth, learning and training and/or focus time. - Professional and managerial skills development training paths, access to e-learning platforms such as O'Reilly, Udemy, Coursera (depending on the department), and to our internal platform offering bespoke training content Other perks: - 2 paid days off per year for volunteering purposes - Occasional social events to foster connections among colleagues - Travel industry discounts and flash exclusive staff fares - We support our employees through life's significant moments with leave options (e.g parental responsibilities, marriages, bereavements, relocations, etc.) in line with local laws. Titolo del lavoro - Machine Learning Scientist

Modello di lavoro - ibrido in Chiasso ufficio

Squadra - Ti unirai al team di Strategic Analytics nel reparto Tecnologia.

Livello - Professional

Ubicazione - Chiasso, Svizzera

Contratto - Permanente - a tempo pieno (36 h / settimana)

Qual è il tuo impatto:

- Sviluppare soluzioni di apprendimento automatico in tempo reale per affrontare problemi complessi del mondo reale sui grandi dati
- Sviluppare algoritmi casuali basati sull'apprendimento profondo
- Collaborare in un team interfunzionale, tra cui scienziati di machine learning, ingegneri software, ingegneri di machine learning e project manager

## Requisiti e competenze

La tua esperienza:

- Un dottorato in Informatica, Matematica o Fisica, o un Master con un minimo di 3 anni di esperienza nell'apprendimento automatico.
- Conoscenza eccellente dei metodi supervisionati (Classificazione, Regressione) e metodi non supervisionati (Clustering, Selezione delle caratteristiche, Riduzione della dimensione)
- Buona conoscenza di Python e SQL, con la conoscenza delle più importanti librerie Python per l'apprendimento delle macchine e l'analisi dei dati (scikit-learn, Pandas, matplotlib, Numpy, Scipy, MLflow)
- Esperienza con Deep Learning (Reti Neurali ricorrenti, Reti Neurali Convoluzionali e Autoencoders)
- Esperienza con Keras (e TensorFlow) o PyTorch
Desiderabile:

- Esperienza nella stima dell'incertezza (Monte Carlo Dropout, Deep Ensembles)
- In grado di trovare soluzioni creative a problemi interessanti
- Curioso con un costante desiderio di imparare e collaborare

## Cosa?

## I vantaggi di lavorare con noi:

## Come lavoriamo insieme: - Un ambiente inclusivo, amichevole e internazionale (si lavorerà con colleghi di +10 paesi e oltre 48 nazionalità) - Una settimana lavorativa più breve, con una mezza giornata di lavoro il venerdì - Inizio flessibile e fine della giornata lavorativa - Possibilità di lavorare da qualsiasi luogo per un periodo di tempo all'anno definito secondo le normative locali Come impariamo insieme: - Fri-Yays: mezza giornata di venerdì mattina con un mandato no-meeting e dedicato al lavoro profondo, alla crescita personale, all'apprendimento e alla formazione e/o al tempo di messa a fuoco. - percorsi formativi professionali e manageriali, accesso a piattaforme e-learning come O'Reilly, Udemy, Coursera (a seconda del dipartimento), e alla nostra piattaforma interna che offre contenuti di formazione su misura Altri vantaggi: - 2 giorni pagati fuori all'anno per scopi di volontariato - Occasionali eventi sociali per favorire connessioni tra colleghi - sconti del settore di viaggio e flash esclusivo personale tariffe - Sosteniamo i nostri dipendenti attraverso i momenti significativi della vita con opzioni di congedo (ad esempio responsabilità genitoriali, matrimoni, lutti, trasferimenti, ecc.) in linea con le leggi locali. Vorrei che fossi qui? Anche noi! Procedura di selezione*:

- Intervista HR (30 minuti)

- 1st intervista (Manager 1 ora): Machine learning + Python coding

- Seconda intervista (Direttore 45 min): competenze morbide + conoscenza dell'apprendimento automatico

- Offerta prolungata

(*Si prega di notare che il processo può leggermente variare. Il responsabile del reclutatore condividerà ulteriori dettagli durante l'installazione dell'intervista)

## Il nostro impegno per celebrare la diversità e generare appartenenza

Al centro della nostra cultura è un impegno per l'inclusione tra razza, genere, età, orientamento sessuale, religione, identità di genere o espressione, e l'accessibilità. Crediamo fortemente in uno spazio pari opportunità, che è accogliente e celebra l'unicità di tutti coloro che lavorano qui. Valoriamo diverse esperienze vissute e punti di vista di rispetto, come sappiamo unicità guida l'innovazione. Vogliamo assicurarci che la nostra gente rifletta le comunità di tutto il mondo che aiutiamo a viaggiare.

## Criteri di idoneità: Inviando le tue informazioni e la tua domanda, confermi che sei legalmente autorizzato a lavorare nel paese di lavoro e che non richiedi la sponsorizzazione del visto per ottenere lo stato del visto di lavoro. Invia il tuo curriculum in inglese Invia il tuo curriculum in inglese

## Chi è lastminute.com

A lastminute.com, viviamo per le vacanze. Siamo il leader europeo Travel-Tech nei pacchetti di vacanza dinamica. Con la tecnologia, trasformiamo pensieri spontanei in esperienze significative, aiutando le persone a viaggiare nel mondo.

Siamo alla ricerca di uno scienziato dell'apprendimento della macchina per unire il nostro team di circa 1.700 persone in tutto il mondo per aiutarci a alimentare il viaggio dei viaggiatori per milioni di h olidaymakers. Se sei uno scienziato motivato di machine learning che ama lavorare con problemi complessi del mondo reale sui grandi dati, continuare a leggere, come si potrebbe essere la soluzione perfetta per questo lavoro.

lastminute.com cerca per la sede di Chiasso un/a Hotel Connectivity Specialist (Channel Managers & Switches). Scopri i dettagli della posizione e candidati online tramite il portale aziendale.

## Global Hotel is lastminute.com group's hotel sourcing and distribution division, managing direct contracts with 23,000+ hotel properties worldwide. We operate sophisticated B2C distribution through the group's consumer brands and are expanding our B2B capabilities through strategic partnerships and technology platforms.

## We are looking for a Hotel Connectivity Specialist to act as the technical and commercial bridge between Global Hotel and the channel managers, switches and connectivity providers that power our hotel distribution. This is a hands-on specialist role, not a product or engineering position. You will be the go-to expert who understands how channel managers and switches work in practice, speaks the technical language of our connectivity partners, and translates what you learn into clear technical gaps and simple, credible business cases for upgrading or expanding our connections.

## Key Responsibilities

- ## Act as the subject-matter expert on channel manager and switch connectivity: ARI distribution (availability, rates, inventory), booking delivery, content and mapping, and rate/availability push and pull.
- ## Engage directly and technically with channel managers, switches and aggregators (e.g. SiteMinder, D-EDGE, Cloudbeds, RateGain, DerbySoft, Availpro) to understand their capabilities, limitations and roadmaps, and benchmark them against each other and against our distribution requirements.
- ## Read and interpret partner API documentation and integration specifications to assess fit against our needs.
- ## Identify technical gaps and limitations in current connections that affect content quality, availability, competitiveness, conversion or operational efficiency.
- ## Diagnose recurring connectivity issues and pinpoint root cause on the partner or protocol side.
- ## Translate technical findings into simple, credible business cases to justify upgrading, replacing or onboarding channel managers and switches, quantifying expected impact coverage, competitiveness, error reduction, operational savings — with data and analytics colleagues.
- ## Support commercial and partnership conversations that require technical depth.
- ## Partner with Product and Engineering during discovery and integration work, coordinating between external partners and internal teams across Europe and Asia.

## Requisiti e competenze

## - 4+ years working hands-on with hotel connectivity (channel managers, switches, connectivity/aggregation platforms) on the OTA, bedbank, channel manager or hotel-tech side.

## - Deep practical understanding of ARI flows, booking delivery, content mapping and connectivity protocols (XML/JSON, push/pull).

## - AI knoweldge

## - Comfortable in technical conversations with connectivity partners: reading API documentation, understanding integration constraints and diagnosing connectivity issues, without needing to be a software engineer.

## - Commercial awareness: able to see the business impact of a technical gap and frame it in a clear, simple business case.

## - Strong communication skills to bridge technical and commercial stakeholders.

## Desirable

## - Detailed familiarity with the channel manager and switch landscape and its key players.

## - Basic SQL and data literacy to support impact analysis.

## - Exposure to GDS, OTA integrations or property management systems.

## - Additional European languages.

## What we offer

## By joining our company, you will have the chance to:

## - Join a dynamic team in an inclusive-international environment

## - Grow thanks to the career journey and our internal mobility perspective

## - Manage your own schedule thanks to the flexible start and end of the working day

## - Work a shorter working week (36h), of which 4 hours on Friday morning

## - Get focus time for learning, development and deep work on Friday mornings

## - Work partially or fully remote according to local laws

## - Enjoy continuous training thanks to our company platform

## - Benefit from employee discounts on travel

## - Receive 2 days off per year for the purpose of volunteering

## - Receive a voucher after some years in the company

## - Get free snacks / fruit / hot drinks / water / beverages at our offices

## - Welfare platform (Corporate Benefits) where you will find dedicated discounts with more than 1500 partners

## Cosa offriamo

## Perks of working with us : How we work together: An inclusive, friendly, and international environment (you’ll be working with colleagues from +10 countries and over 48 nationalities) Shorter working week (36h as full time), with a half working day on Fridays Flexible start and end of the working day, with core hours from 10:00 to 4:00 pm Possibility to work from anywhere for a period of time per year defined according to local regulations How we learn together : Fri-Yays: half a day on Friday morning with a no-meeting mandate and dedicated to deep work, personal growth, learning and training and/or focus time. Crediamo fortemente in uno spazio pari opportunità, che è accogliente e celebra l'unicità di tutti coloro che lavorano qui. Vogliamo assicurarci che la nostra gente rifletta le comunità di tutto il mondo che aiutiamo a viaggiare.

Inviando le vostre informazioni e la vostra domanda, confermate che siete legalmente autorizzati a lavorare nel paese di lavoro e che non richiedete la sponsorizzazione del visto per ottenere lo stato del visto di lavoro.

## La nostra missione è di guidare il settore dei viaggi sfruttando la tecnologia per semplificare, personalizzare e migliorare l'esperienza di viaggio dei nostri clienti. Esperti nel rallegrare i viaggi online, aiutiamo i nostri clienti a trovare e fare "qualunque cosa li rende rosa".

## Investiamo continuamente in persone di talento che garantiscono la nostra offerta è più vicino alle esigenze dei clienti e ci tengono all'avanguardia dell'evoluzione tecnologica. Gestiamo la nostra attività in 17 lingue e 40 paesi, con oltre 1.500 dipendenti distribuiti in tutto il mondo, sviluppando i nostri prodotti e servizi per alimentare l'intero viaggio per milioni di persone.

JOB DESCRIPTION

## We are looking for an AI Automation Engineer to help us power up the traveller's journey for millions of holidaymakers. If you are passionate about designing & building AI solutions, keep on reading, as you might be the perfect fit for this job. The job in brief: Job Title - AI Automation Engineer Working model - hybrid from Switzerland Team - you will join the Automation Engineering team within the Automation department. Level - Professional Location - Chiasso, Switzerland (only for hybrid positions) Contract - Permanent - full-time (EUR 36 h/week) What your impact will be: Build and scale n8n automation workflows. Design, build, and maintain production-grade workflows on our self-hosted n8n Enterprise platform (AWS EKS), supporting business units across the company and helping grow our Citizen Developer / self-service automation program. Design and build custom AI solutions. Develop applications and tools that use AI to support key business processes. These solutions will be tailored to specific needs across different departments. Connect AI tools with our systems. Integrate external AI platforms (such as OpenAI, Google Gemini or Anthropic Claude) with our existing tools using APIs, low-code platforms like n8n, and custom connectors. Contribute to our governed knowledge layer. Support and extend our Company Context / Universal RAG Knowledge Base, including document ingestion pipelines, retrieval quality, and access governance. Work with natural language processing (NLP). Create tools for analyzing conversations, automating emails, and generating insights from customer interactions. Build generative AI solutions. Use generative AI to automate tasks like content creation and communication personalization. Maintain and improve systems. Update code, monitor system performance, and retrain models regularly to ensure everything runs smoothly. Collaborate with tech teams. Work closely with data engineers, DevOps, and other developers to make sure AI tools are scalable and reliable. What You Might Build: n8n workflows automating cross-department processes NLP-based systems that analyze calls and emails RAG-powered assistants and chatbots grounded in our Company Context knowledge base Virtual assistants and chatbots to support internal teams Recommendation engines that guide real-time sales or support actions Automated tools to generate personalized content Dashboards and reporting tools that surface AI-generated insights Your expertise: 3+ years of hands-on AI development: You’ve built and shipped AI solutions that led to real business impact—whether that’s increased revenue, reduced cost, or improved customer satisfaction (NPS). Fast, practical builder: You move quickly from idea to working prototype, and improve as you go. You aim for results, not perfection. End-to-end problem solver: You take ownership from idea to deployment—writing documentation only when needed, and focusing on what works. Strong technical troubleshooting: You can quickly find the cause of technical issues using logs, dev tools, or pattern matching. Security-aware mindset: You understand authentication, authorization scopes, and safe handling of credentials. Communicator and storyteller: You present your ideas clearly, show live demos with confidence, and help business teams understand the value of your work. Your Skills and Tools Automation Platforms: Hands-on experience with n8n (or similar low-code platforms such as Make, Zapier), including self-hosted/enterprise deployments. Languages: Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript. AI/ML Development: Experience with LLMs (e.g. Claude, Gemini, OpenAI), prompt engineering, and building agentic workflows; familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch is a plus. RAG & Knowledge Systems: Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, and document ingestion pipelines. Data & APIs: Strong understanding of APIs, cloud-based infrastructure, and microservices architecture. Software Practices: Familiar with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and the full software development lifecycle. Cloud & Deployment: Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), container tools (Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures.
